notes: Badges now earn XP: a major badge pays 100 and a minor badge pays 50, added to your total alongside the work that unlocked it
Every badge you had already unlocked is paid in full as soon as you update - the total counts unlocked badges whenever you earned them, so nothing is left out, and nothing ever takes XP away
The XP breakdown shows your badge XP as its own line, and the Progress and badges card tells you once what your existing badges are worth
